Create a prey calibration sequence in Par

Source: R/functions-inputs_setup.R
set_prey_sequence_in_par.Rd

Generates a sequence of prey values spanning a specified range and assigns it to Par$Pmedian. The number of values generated is determined by modPar$Nreplicates.

Usage

set_prey_sequence_in_par(Par, modPar, Pmin, Pmax)

Arguments

Par

A seabORD parameter list.

modPar

A seabORD model parameter list containing Nreplicates.

Pmin

Minimum prey value.

Pmax

Maximum prey value.

Value

The updated Par object with Pmedian populated.

Examples

Par_example <- set_prey_sequence_in_par(
  Par = Par_example,
  modPar = modPar_example,
  Pmin = 150,
  Pmax = 200
)
#> Error: object 'modPar_example' not found
